Author: dajoey
Name: PvP Solver
Description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Changelog:
v0.1.0.3 - Wholly Original Rebrand & PvP Cast Protection
- Renamed all commands to /pvpsolver and /pvs to prevent collisions with stock RSR.
- Built protection against autocasting when zero enemies are nearby in PvP zones.

Author: dajoey
Name: Dagobert - Price Matcher
Punchline: Matches (instead of undercuts) market board prices
Description: Fork of Dagobert - matches the lowest market board price instead of undercutting. Default amount is 0 (exact match). You can still set a negative amount to undercut if desired.
Changelog:
v1.12.0.4 - Hide inventory context menu entry
- Synced upstream Dagobert v1.14.1.0: new Show inventory context menu entry toggle (on by default) in the config window. Turn it off to remove Dagoberts right-click entry from inventory items.
- Fork behavior preserved: matches the lowest market board price (0 undercut by default); /pricematch command unchanged.

Author: dajoey
Name: AutoPotion
Punchline: Per-job HP, MP, and deep dungeon potion automation
Description: Auto-uses the highest-tier HP potion, MP potion (Ether), and the deep dungeon regen potion (Sustaining / Eurekan / Orthos / Pilgrim's) at configurable thresholds. Each potion's threshold and on/off state is stored per-job, so casters and tanks can have completely different setups.

Author: dajoey
Name: Armoire Auto-Fill
Punchline: Per-dungeon view of which armoire-eligible gear pieces you're still missing
Description: Lists every armoire-eligible dungeon drop in the game and shows whether each is in your inventory, in your armoire, or still missing. Sort by level, hide completed dungeons, toggle to show owned items too. Open the armoire UI at an inn once per session to populate the in-armoire state; in-inventory and equipped state is detected automatically. Use /armoire.

Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.63 (TESTING) - SGE/SCH shield handed back to the combo path.
- The controller direct-cast (1.0.4.57) + Run-hold (1.0.4.61) were starving the combo - the path that actually casts Eukrasian Prognosis and won't let Eukrasian Dosis steal the Eukrasia. Removed them; the combo owns the shield, mitigation is held until it lands. REQUIRES the sub-preset on (SGE_Raidwide -> Eukrasian Prognosis).

v1.0.4.62 (TESTING, DIAGNOSTIC) - shield-path logging.
- Temporary [RWS] log lines in the SGE/SCH raidwide-shield path so we can see exactly where it breaks (open /xllog, filter on RWS, trigger a boss raidwide, paste the lines). No behavior change.

v1.0.4.61 (TESTING) - SGE Eukrasian Prognosis follow-up (the rotation was eating the Eukrasia).
- When Eukrasia was not already up, the shield cast Eukrasia but the DPS rotation immediately spent it on Eukrasian Dosis before Eukrasian Prognosis - so it only worked when Eukrasia happened to already be up. Now the rotation is held for the one tick between Eukrasia and Prognosis so nothing eats the Eukrasia.

v1.0.4.60 (TESTING) - SGE Eukrasian Prognosis cast (missing self target id).
- The working AoE-heal combos cast it as UseAction(base Prognosis, self GameObjectId) and the game transforms it. v58 missed the self target id; v59 wrongly added a Retarget on the explicit Eukrasian id (Prognosis takes no selectable target). Now mirrors the proven cast: base Prognosis + self target. SCH Succor also passes the self target now.

v1.0.4.59 (TESTING) - SGE Eukrasian Prognosis follow-up fix.
- Eukrasia fired but Eukrasian Prognosis didn't. Now cast the same way the working tank-shield casts Eukrasian Diagnosis: explicit Eukrasian Prognosis id + Retarget(Self) + a self target id. (Base Prognosis and no-target both failed to fire.)

v1.0.4.58 (TESTING) - SGE Eukrasian Prognosis cast fix.
- v1.0.4.57 fired the Eukrasian* action id directly, which the game won't cast, so the SGE shield didn't go out at all. Now uses the base Prognosis with Eukrasia up (the game transforms it), matching how Eukrasian Dosis is cast. The shield also only marks its cooldown on a successful cast, so a missed cast retries.

v1.0.4.57 (TESTING) - SGE/SCH raidwide shield reliability fix.
- The AoE shield (Eukrasian Prognosis / Succor) now fires directly from the auto-rotation controller, FIRST, the same reliable way the mitigations do - instead of depending on the per-job combo path + sub-preset. Fixes the shield only working sometimes / "feeling like upstream." No separate sub-toggle needed for auto-rotation; it fires whenever raidwide handling is on.

v1.0.4.56 (TESTING) - Raidwide shield reliability fix.
- Removed the cast-interrupt for SGE/SCH raidwide shields: cancelling the current cast could leave the shield unable to start ("stops casting but doesn't cast the shield"). The shield is still highest priority and now slots in cleanly on the next GCD instead.

v1.0.4.55 (TESTING) - Healer raidwide upgrades.
- SGE/SCH now cast their AoE shield (Eukrasian Prognosis / Succor) FIRST on a raidwide or stack, then one mitigation - new 10s shield gate separate from the 15s mit gate; auto-rotation cancels an in-progress damage cast so the shield goes out instantly.
- AST: Aspected Helios / Helios Conjunction regen is now timed to land right after the hit and works off Neutral Sect.
- WHM: new 'RaidWide Medica II/III' option times Medica so its regen lands as the hit resolves.
- SGE: new 'Tank Shield Upkeep' option keeps Eukrasian Diagnosis on a tank with >2 enemies and spends Addersting via Toxikon at cap.

v1.0.4.54 - Upstream sync: WrathCombo main 1.0.4.9 tip (3 commits: autorotation override-target handling)
- Merged upstream 06877cca..1c7049c64; all Gluttony fork divergences preserved (15s raidwide-mit gate, Pyretic/Pacification/Silence handling, WHM Divine Caress ground-heal, BLU engine, SMN Aegis Uptime).
- Autorotation: the override target is now cleared automatically when it points at a dead/invalid object, and wiped when autorotation is disabled, instead of being nulled at every early-exit. Fewer stale-target edge cases.
- Autorotation: ability queueing now respects the configured queue window (AnimationLock <= QueueWindow) instead of requiring a zero animation lock, so weaved oGCDs fire more reliably.
- Target: HasBattleTarget() is now null-safe and the override-target getter self-wipes dead targets.

Author: croizat, dajoey
Name: Lazy Fate Automation
Punchline: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
Description: Automates FATE grinding, including Zodiac Atma, Anima Luminous Crystals, Resistance Memories, Phantom Demiatmas, Yo-kai Watch Medals, and Bicolor Gemstones. Seamlessly integrates with vnavmesh for pathing and flight, lifestream for zone swapping, TextAdvance for dialogue skipping, and Gluttony Combo/BossMod for combat. Use /lazyfate to open.
Changelog:
v0.0.1.44 - Stop halts vnavmesh
- Stop now immediately cancels vnavmesh pathfinding and movement, instead of letting the bot finish walking/flying to its destination after you hit Stop.

v0.0.1.43 - Release Gluttony on Stop
- Stop now fully releases the Gluttony Combo lease (returns control to you) instead of just turning auto-rotation off.

v0.0.1.42 - Preset name cleanup
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset to just "Gluttony" (dropped the leftover "CBT -" prefix).

v0.0.1.41 - Gluttony crash hotfix
- Fixed a lease-registration loop that piled up duplicate Gluttony Combo leases, crashing Gluttony's UI/rotation and tanking FPS. The lease is now acquired exactly once and never churned.
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset "CBT - DwD" to "CBT - Gluttony" so the status bar shows the right engine.
- After updating, reload Gluttony Combo (or restart the game) once to clear orphaned registrations from v0.0.1.40.

v0.0.1.40 - Gluttony Combo combat
- Combat rotation and target selection are now handled by Gluttony Combo (lease-based Auto-Rotation) instead of BossMod's DwD autorotation.
- BossMod is kept only for movement and danger avoidance, and yields target authority to Gluttony (Retarget=NoTarget, FATE priority).
- Gluttony is configured for FATE grinding: nearest-target, FATE priority, always hard-target so movement follows, AoE at 3+.

v0.0.1.38 - 2026-06-09
- Prevented mounting and dismounting loops after FATE completion by keeping the bot in Engaging state (clearing remaining combat) before transitioning to BetweenFates or deactivating integrations.

v0.0.1.35 - 2026-06-07
- Stop movement and remove dismount/landing logic from `TeleportTo` pre-cast checks. Teleport casts will now initiate directly while remaining mounted.
- Exclude city hubs (where mounting is disabled) from random zone swapping, gemstone allowed zones, relic allowed zones, and the UI zone selector.

v0.0.1.34 - 2026-06-07
- Added stuck check mitigation for combat/engage pathfinding fallbacks.
- Wait for combat to end before mounting.

v0.0.1.33 - 2026-06-07
- Only dismount before teleporting if the player is flying (`Player.InFlight` is true). If the player is mounted on the ground, they will now remain mounted while teleporting, which makes travels faster and more natural.
- Added robust mounting verification and retry loops inside `MoveTo()`. If the player is in combat, the bot stands still and waits for combat to end before attempting to mount.
- Added mid-travel dismount checking inside `MoveTo()` pathfinding loops. If the player is dismounted mid-travel (e.g. from getting aggroed/hit), the bot halts movement, waits for combat to end, mounts up, and resumes pathfinding rather than walking on foot.
- Rewrote combat/engage stuck detection in `HandleCombatStuckDetection()`. Instead of depending on `InCombat` (which is false when running between FATE mobs) or `IsMoving` (which returns false when stuck against a wall), it now tracks position changes relative to the current target and activates `vnavmesh` pathing fallback if progress towards a distant target stops for 1.5 seconds.
- Added explicit landing and dismounting calls at the beginning of `TeleportTo()`, and wait for `!Player.IsBusy` to prevent teleport casts from immediately failing when mounted/flying.
- Fixed task crashing on teleport failures by replacing `ErrorIf(!ActionManager.Teleport())` with a robust 3-attempt retry loop that falls back to the `/return` recovery gracefully.

v0.0.1.26 - 2026-06-07
- Added combat stuck detection and mitigation in `HandleCombatStuckDetection()`. If BossMod's straight-line movement gets the player stuck on trees/obstacles in combat for 1.5 seconds, the bot disables BossMod movement and uses `vnavmesh` to pathfind around the obstacle to the target.
- Added auto-skipping for NPC dialogue SelectString option lists in `TaskBase.WaitUntilSkipping()`.
- Gated teleporting and mounting on `!Svc.Condition[ConditionFlag.InCombat]` in `TaskBase.cs` to prevent getting stuck in combat.
- Prevented rapid mounting and dismounting loops during chain FATEs while waiting for the next FATE to spawn.

v0.0.1.23 - 2026-06-06
- File logging now suppresses DBG/TRC scope tracing by default; only WRN/ERR are written to LazyFateAutomation.log. Set VerboseFileLogging to true in the plugin config (LazyFateAutomation.json) to restore full debug logging for troubleshooting. (Svc.cs LogToFile gate, Configuration.cs flag.)
- Fixes ~28 MB log growth observed 2026-06-06 from FATE-grind DebugContext scope enter/exit tracing.

Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Skyward Tracker
Punchline: Track your Skyward points for all jobs toward the Pteranodon mount
Description: Tracks all jobs' Skyward points for the Pteranodon mount achievement. Scans your inventory for Skybuilders turn-in items and projects how many points they'll add, shown as a cyan bar extension on each job's progress bar. Use /lazysky to open.
Changelog:
v0.0.2.2 - Fix gathered Diadem items counting toward the wrong gathering class
- Miner quarry materials that lack an "ore/stone/sand" keyword (Spring Water, Truespring Water, Cloud Drop Water, Basalt, Jade, Lutinite, Alumen, Clay, Granite, Silex, Ice Stalagmite, Fossil Dust, Basilisk Egg, and the Umbral Levinshard/Levinite/Magma Shard line) were being credited to Botanist instead of Miner.
- Gathering class is now read from the game's HWDGathererInspection row index (1=Miner, 2=Botanist, 3=Fisher) instead of an item-name heuristic. 18 point-bearing Miner items across Grades 2-4 fixed.
- No change to which items count or their point values.

Author: dajoey
Name: LazyFoodBuff
Punchline: Never forget to eat your food again.
Description: Auto-eats food in combat duties with per-job food selection, auto-select based on best stats, and a low-food warning. Fires in combat duties (dungeons, raids, trials, alliance raids, criterion, variant, deep dungeons). Understands optimal stats for every job and auto-selects the best food from your inventory.
Changelog:
v0.1.1.0 - Low-food warning + deep dungeons. (1) The low-stock alert now triggers on how much food you have left in your bag, not on time remaining on the buff; new count slider (default 3), alerts once and re-arms after you restock. (2) Auto-eat now works in deep dungeons (Palace of the Dead, Heaven-on-High, Eureka Orthos) - they were wrongly excluded.
v0.1.0.0 - Initial release. Auto-eats food in combat duties; per-job food selection or auto-select by best stats; refresh-before-expiry. Use /lazyfoodbuff.
